title: Zustand vs Context for Global State

scenes.say: Ever wonder when to use Zustand or React Context for global state? Let's break it down.

scenes.label: Zustand
scenes.sub: Minimal state library. Uses hooks. Great for global state.
scenes.say: Zustand is a minimal state library. It uses hooks and is perfect for sharing global state across your app.

scenes.label: Context
scenes.sub: Lets you pass data without props. Best for low-frequency updates.
scenes.say: React Context lets you pass data through the component tree without props. It's best for low-frequency updates.
Context is simple and ideal for small state or rare updates. Zustand is easier to set up for global state and frequent changes.

scenes.question: Why not always use Redux?
scenes.wrong: Redux is always best for global state.
scenes.right: Redux is powerful, but Zustand and Context are lighter and easier for small apps.
scenes.say: Don't assume Redux is always the answer. For small apps, Zustand or Context can be lighter and easier.
